# Zaheer Studio Trades

> A vertical of focused, jobsite-grade software tools for general contractors, electrical subcontractors, mechanical and plumbing subs, remodelers, and specialty trades. Hub: https://www.zaheer.studio/trades

## Who it serves

- General contractors (GCs)
- Electrical subcontractors
- Mechanical and HVAC subcontractors
- Plumbing subcontractors
- Remodelers
- Specialty trades and small crews

## Tools in the vertical

### PermitPilot — https://www.zaheer.studio/trades/permitpilot

Jurisdiction-specific building permit checklists for contractors, GCs, and remodelers. Pick a city, pick a project type, get a plain-English checklist of every permit, document, and inspection required before submittal. 49+ US jurisdictions, expanding weekly. Free to try. Status: live.

### BackBill — https://www.zaheer.studio/trades/backbill

Voice-first Change Order Request software for electrical and specialty subcontractors. Capture jobsite extras with a 30-second voice memo; AI drafts a polished, line-itemized COR; PDF is emailed to the GC with a one-click approval link. $29/month, 14-day free trial. Status: in development (Phase 1 deployed).

## Why this vertical exists

Most software for the trades is built for fifty-person enterprise general contractors with budgets to match. Zaheer Studio Trades exists to give the smaller operators — the ones working in the truck, on the jobsite, with one or two crews — software that fits how they actually work. Mobile-first. Jobsite-tested. Priced like a tool, not a license.

## Common questions

**Who is Zaheer Studio Trades for?**
Contractors, subcontractors, remodelers, and specialty trade businesses who don't have an enterprise budget and need software designed for the field.

**What does it cost?**
PermitPilot is free to try. BackBill is $29/month with a 14-day free trial — no credit card to start.

**How do I request a feature or a city?**
Email info@zaheer.studio. New jurisdictions for PermitPilot ship on request. Feature requests for BackBill go straight to the roadmap.
